title: Hybrid QPE-Ansatz Strategy for Reliable Excited-State Variational Quantum Deflation
summary: We introduce a spin $z$-component ($S_{z}$) conserving symmetry-preserving ansatz and a shallow quantum phase estimation (QPE) routine of spin $x$ ($S_x$), and combine them into a spin-filtering variational quantum deflation (sfVQD) scheme for noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) computing era excited state calculations. The scheme encodes the spin information into a small ancilla register through controlled rotations under $\mathrm{exp} (iθ\hat{S}_{x})$ with only modest circuit overhead.
